title: Path of Exile 2
subtitle: 20 years later — Corruption rises, Ancient Threats return

cards.title: The World 20 Years Later (1619 IC)
cards.text: Rebuilding efforts: Immortal Syndicate operates in the shadows. Arimor Line — defensive perimeter. Kingsmarch — second Kalguur colony. Oriath attempts civilian governance.
cards.flavorText: "Civilizations rise and fall. We are just the next chapter." — Alva Valai

cards.title: Twilight Order & Corruption Returns
cards.text: The Twilight Order — a secret organization that stole the Seed of Corruption. The new Exile begins at Ogham (Ezomyte homeland). Count of Ogham rules through necromancy. Corruption spreads across Wraeclast.
cards.flavorText: "Death is not the end. It is the beginning of obedience." — Count of Ogham

cards.title: The 5-Act Journey
cards.text: Act 1: Ogham — liberation from the Count. Act 2: Vastiri — pursuing the Beast. Act 3: Utzaal — finding Doryani (Vaal expert). Act 4: Ngamakanui — searching for the Weapon (Third Edict). Act 5: Oriath — confronting the Twilight Order.

cards.title: Doryani & The Ancient Weapon
cards.text: Doryani — ancient Vaal thaumaturgist — survived through immortality experiments. Becomes an ally. Helps research Precursor ruins, find the Weapon — Instrument of the Third Edict — failsafe to destroy the Seed of Corruption.
cards.flavorText: "If they had completed the tower network, it could have changed the face of the world..." — Precursor Tablet
